name: Blinded
description: Cannot see; automatically fails any check that needs sight. Attack rolls against the creature have advantage and its own attack rolls have disadvantage. Advantage and disadvantage are applied by the players; no numeric effect.

name: Charmed
description: Cannot attack the charmer or target them with harmful abilities or magic. The charmer has advantage on social checks against the creature.

name: Deafened
description: Cannot hear; automatically fails any check that needs hearing.

name: Exhaustion
description: Six cumulative levels: 1 disadvantage on ability checks, 2 speed halved, 3 disadvantage on attacks and saves, 4 hit point maximum halved, 5 speed 0, 6 death. Track the level in notes; the effects are applied by the players.

name: Frightened
description: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is in sight; cannot willingly move closer to it.

name: Grappled
description: Speed becomes 0 and no bonus to speed applies. Ends if the grappler is incapacitated or the creature is moved out of reach.

name: Invisible
description: Cannot be seen without magic or a special sense; counts as heavily obscured for hiding. Attack rolls against the creature have disadvantage and its own attack rolls have advantage.

name: Paralyzed
description: Incapacitated, cannot move or speak, automatically fails STR and DEX saves. Attacks against the creature have advantage and hits from within 5 feet are critical hits. Speed 0.

name: Petrified
description: Turned to stone: incapacitated, unaware, weight times ten, resistance to all damage, immune to poison and disease, automatically fails STR and DEX saves. Speed 0.

name: Poisoned
description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

name: Prone
description: Can only crawl until standing up, which costs half the movement. Disadvantage on attack rolls; attacks against the creature have advantage from within 5 feet and disadvantage from further away.

name: Restrained
description: Speed 0. Attack rolls against the creature have advantage, its own have disadvantage, and it has disadvantage on DEX saves.

name: Stunned
description: Incapacitated, cannot move, speaks only falteringly, automatically fails STR and DEX saves. Attacks against the creature have advantage. Speed 0.

name: Unconscious
description: Incapacitated, unaware, drops what it holds and falls prone, automatically fails STR and DEX saves. Attacks against the creature have advantage and hits from within 5 feet are critical hits. Speed 0.

name: Shield of Faith
description: A shimmering field of protection grants +2 to Armor Class for up to 10 minutes while the caster concentrates.
